## Definition of Done

See [docs/ROADMAP.md, section 3.5](https://github.com/onewmann/sigstack/blob/main/docs/ROADMAP.md#35-definition-of-done).

- [ ] Merged via pull request, CI green on Ubuntu and Windows
- [ ] Unit tests; for blocks also the chunking test
- [ ] C++ kernels: tested against the Python reference, tolerance stated (if C++ changed)
- [ ] Public API has docstrings and appears in the docs
- [ ] Example or test with a synthetic signal
- [ ] Changelog entry under `[Unreleased]`
